mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to historical averages indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% (UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a weakening labor market, suppressing consumer demand and corporate profitability, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the central bank's policy shift to reduce liquidity increases discount rates and credit costs, depressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) relative to historical averages indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST is above the 75th percentile, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing output and supply chain resilience, signaling positive economic momentum and corporate profit growth, which leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is above the 75th percentile, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) confirms robust economic expansion, driving corporate earnings momentum and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both INDPRO and GDPC1 are rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1500.0 (HOUST) signals strong residential investment and consumer confidence, boosting aggregate demand and corporate revenue, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
